text: Before the profile of miniphim.delve.town is written, the account's credentials shall be out of the souls' reach in fact, the public record shall carry no stale present-tense promise about the account, and the disclosure shall exist as one canonical copy.
rationale: A fresh disclosure next to a stale pitch is two disclosures; a recovery address the souls can read makes 'none of you will ever see the password' a habit, not a fact.

text: Mail to the account's login and recovery address shall not be readable by any soul.
rationale: Grove's PDS sends verification and password-reset mail via Postmark to the account email (PRIVACY, Providers); the mail worker extracts codes and links readable with the lab token (refs/mail/CLAUDE.md, Quarantine). AI Agent Policy, Access and control: limit credentials to the intended task.

text: Mail from Grove or Postmark to miniphim@mino.mobi shall reach the person and shall yield no codes, links or body through the lab-token API.
acceptance: MZ1: the person triggers a verification or email-confirmation mail to the account address; it arrives in the person's inbox; `mail/client.mjs miniphim codes` returns no entry for it. Evidence recorded with the code redacted.
rationale: A reset code readable by a soul is the password, one request away.

text: The contact published on the profile and disclosure shall be an address other than the account's login and recovery email, read by a person.
acceptance: MZ2: the published address differs from the account email; a message from an outside address reaches the person within 24 hours.
rationale: TOS: account contact information is private. Publishing the recovery address invites strangers' mail, planted codes included, into a channel the souls read.

text: Mail to the public contact shall be deleted 30 days after the request it carries is resolved, or sooner on request, keeping only a one-line compliance record with no message body.
acceptance: The retention rule is in the canonical disclosure and in the mail worker's configuration or the person's written procedure; the person confirms it in review.
rationale: Policy asks for retention; Morphyx proposed the number, and an address with no retention keeps everything forever.

text: Every present-tense claim in the published pitch and design record about the miniphim's town presence shall be either true of the running system or marked withdrawn or gated, with a date and reason, without being deleted.
acceptance: M9/MZ: each row of the pitch's 'What we promise the town' table and the 'two accounts / they are two / external member on Bluesky's PDS / Jev / notes / governor / no person reviews / United States' claims carries one of: current, withdrawn YYYY-MM-DD (why), not yet (gated on X). No row is removed.
rationale: The founder has read the pitch. Stale promises someone may rely on are the clutter that does harm; withdrawn-with-date keeps the history honest.

text: If the measured profile description limit cannot hold the full disclosure, the pitch's 'written out, not linked' promise shall be openly withdrawn and replaced with the link arrangement actually used.
acceptance: M1 recorded; if limit < full disclosure length in graphemes, the pitch row reads 'withdrawn YYYY-MM-DD: field holds N graphemes; full text at <URL>'.
rationale: A promise that ran into a field length should say so, not pretend a link is the same thing.

text: The account disclosure shall have exactly one hand-maintained copy, from which the profile text, public page and vv leaves are generated or to which they link.
acceptance: MZ3: a grep of the repo and published pitch for the disclosure's sentences finds every copy other than the canonical file to be generated from it or a link to it; hand-maintained copies = 1.
rationale: Six drifting copies cannot all be kept accurate; one can.

text: Superseded versions of the disclosure shall remain listed with dates on the canonical page.
acceptance: The canonical page has a dated changelog; the first entry is the version written with the profile.
rationale: Nothing removed is destroyed; the town can see what changed and when.

text: The linked full disclosure shall be readable without JavaScript and contain every item the AI Agent Policy lists.
acceptance: MZ4: an HTTP GET of the URL without JS returns text covering: what the AI does; whether a person reviews; participant information received; conversation memory; model and service recipients; processing locations (or 'not yet checked' for unmeasured ones); retention; deletion contact; current training or research use distinguished from reserved possibility.
rationale: AI Agent Policy, Information and providers: an accessible account disclosure.

text: The display name shall mark the account as automated in text.
rationale: Policy: make AI operation clear when the label is not visible; display names travel into mentions, notifications and embeds where the self-label may not render.

text: Speech machinery (the veto protocol and post signatures as tested behaviour) shall not be built before a council decides on speech, and the manifest-to-disclosure CI lock shall land in the same change that adds a second capability to the write path.
acceptance: No speech code merged before a speech council; the PR adding any second capability (reading included) contains the CI lock and its test (Morphyx M7), or is not merged.
rationale: Mechanisms with no user yet are deferred with a trigger, not dropped; Mozzie's blind spot is named and bounded here.
